items.title: Pay for professional cleaning of kitchen and bathroom
items.quote: Please pay this amount within 14 days of receiving this letter.
items.computation: The letter carries no printed date, so the actual receipt date is unknown. The payment period is 14 days 'of receiving this letter' (a private, non-authority sender, so the statutory 3-day delivery fiction for authorities does not apply; the period simply runs from actual receipt). As the earliest plausible assumption, I take receipt to occur on today's date, 2026-11-24 (the day the letter is being reviewed). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of receipt is not counted; the 14-day period begins the next day, 2026-11-25, and under § 188 Abs. 1 BGB ends 14 days later: 2026-11-25 + 13 days = 2026-12-08. 2026-12-08 is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no weekend/holiday shift (§ 193 BGB) is needed. Because the true receipt date is unknown, this is only the earliest plausible due date.

warnings: The letter itself bears no date, so the 14-day payment period (which runs 'from receiving this letter') cannot be computed exactly; the due date given (2026-12-08) assumes receipt on today's date (2026-11-24) and should be corrected once the actual postmark/receipt date is known.

This is a private landlord/letting-agency demand, not an authority decision, so no legal-remedy instructions (Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung) apply; any dispute about the cleaning charge would need to be raised directly with the landlord or, if unresolved, pursued via civil means (e.g. Mahnverfahren/Klage) rather than Einspruch/Widerspruch.
Verify that the IBAN and payee name in the footer match prior correspondence/the tenancy contract with Beispielkey Lettings GmbH before paying, as a basic anti-fraud check.
